newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IDEX started as outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IDEX started as outperform.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of IDEX Corp with an outperform rating for both the intermediate six-month and long-term 18-month periods.
--Its intermediate-term price objective is $49 and long-term, $53.
--EVEREN projects EPS for of $2.52 in 1996 vs $2.30 last year. Its 1997 EPS estimate is $2.95.
--IDEX, which makes products for fluid handling and other industrial uses, was trading at 40, up 1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange at 1240 EST/1740 GMT.
